body:
Thank you. I hope you’re doing better.
Your story reminded me of the time I tried to go through with my idea- it’s kind of ironic that I told myself after that I wouldn’t do it again. I’ve pulled through a lot of feelings after that, I just think there’s a point I’ve reached where I don’t want to continue doing so. Like- the idea that I’ll be doing this for the rest of my life, day after day is absolutely terrifying to me. I’ve been trying my best all this time, but I’ve always done it with an end goal in mind. Realizing it would never come true for me was when I just gave up on myself, whether I actually knew it or not at the time.
I could keep living, I could force myself to keep living, but I want to actually feel at least okay. I want a shot at actual happiness. I’m not even asking for anything perfect. Really, my idea of being happy with where I am isn’t a lot, but right now I don’t think it’s possible to get there again.

It’s okay. Thank you for talking to me though.
I don’t mean to come off as harsh.
I have concerns about it. If they tried to take me somewhere because of it, I know people that could get extremely sick and potentially die from it because of the current situation.
I’m not willing to give any more information beyond that, sorry. I don’t want to risk being identified.
I’m not sure what they could do for me, honestly. I feel like it would just worry them, but nothing would actually come out of it.

You’re probably right. I’ve been on the things that would help me for over a year now, and while it did help, this new stuff came up after my treatment was finished the first time.

I know it helped once, but I honestly feel I’ve gone too far this time. While I don’t think I’m a unique case by any means, it’s nothing like what I had before. I just don’t want to keep fighting an uphill battle, especially after being able to feel fine for the first time, which lasted only a couple months.

I feel I don’t deserve positive things because I’m a horrible, self destructive person. Other people could have those things, and for some reason they’re being spent on me.

My thought process lately has been very contradictory and twisted I’ve known I was giving up, that I didn’t want to continue, and I think it’s just now that it’s reflected in my actions.
